rows.capability: Whole-package Python ECGBench runtime dependency
rows.reason: The Node-governed target does not need a parallel Python runtime with numpy/pandas/scikit-learn plus optional torch/WFDB/data-format dependencies.

rows.capability: Curated 64-dataset ECG catalogue
rows.reason: Useful source/discovery metadata only. Every underlying dataset retains separate data-use terms and source labels remain non-gold.

rows.capability: Dataset source URL access license and provenance front matter
rows.reason: Useful provenance metadata, but donor-reported dataset terms are not independent legal verification and must be checked per dataset before use.

rows.capability: Config-driven dataset schema
rows.reason: Useful for offline dataset normalization and reproducibility design; no config becomes runtime authority.

rows.capability: Concrete dataset configurations for 51 supported datasets plus template
rows.reason: Configuration metadata may inform future dataset adapters, but each referenced dataset remains separately licensed and non-gold.

rows.capability: Deterministic stratified 10-fold splitting
rows.reason: Useful evaluation methodology with fixed random seed; not clinical evidence or runtime behavior.

rows.capability: Patient-grouped StratifiedGroupKFold splitting
rows.reason: Strong leakage-control pattern for offline evaluation; patient grouping does not establish label validity.

rows.capability: Ungrouped StratifiedKFold fallback
rows.reason: Useful only when grouping identifiers are unavailable and must not be mistaken for stronger patient-isolated evaluation.

rows.capability: Preservation of predefined source fold assignments
rows.reason: Useful protocol-preservation concept when the source defines folds; remains source-evaluation metadata.

rows.capability: Custom fold rotation without concatenated dataset wrappers
rows.reason: Supports controlled cross-validation experiments while preserving fold identity.

rows.capability: Identification-only split CSV export with labels kept at source
rows.reason: The target already enforces SOURCE LABELS distinct from PROJECT GOLD and preserves provenance; donor split discipline reinforces but does not replace it.

rows.capability: Published fold artifacts on Hugging Face Hub
rows.reason: External split artifacts are separate bytes with separate provenance/terms; none are imported or treated as immutable target evidence.

rows.capability: Unified optional PyTorch ECGDataset loader and collator
rows.reason: Broad dataset loading is useful research infrastructure but would expand runtime dependencies and data-format attack surface.

rows.capability: WFDB CSV OpenSignals NPY HDF5 EDF and MAT signal loaders
rows.reason: Prior donor audits already cover WFDB and broad data-access concerns; target keeps narrower explicit source contracts.

rows.capability: Lead selection alternate-layout and per-record lead-name handling
rows.reason: Dataset-specific lead caveats are valuable for evaluation but cannot grant lead identity authority to inferred metadata.

rows.capability: Windowed signal access and unit conversion
rows.reason: Target already has explicit bounded signal windows and calibration provenance; donor behavior is not adopted as canonical.

rows.capability: Dataset-specific label loader suite
rows.reason: Useful source-label extraction knowledge; all outputs remain SOURCE LABELS and never become PROJECT GOLD automatically.

rows.capability: QTDB beat-level delineation annotation loader
rows.reason: Potential future delineation-evaluation source labels only; no annotation bytes are imported.

rows.capability: European ST-T episode inventory loader
rows.reason: Episode annotations may inform future evaluation but remain external source labels and non-gold.

rows.capability: Challenge 2020/2021 diagnosis mapping CSVs
rows.reason: Tracked mapping content derives from external challenge vocabularies; software MIT terms are not assumed to establish independent data/vocabulary rights.

rows.capability: Missing-lead validation
rows.reason: Target input-quality guard already fails closed on missing or unverified leads with stronger authority boundaries.

rows.capability: Flat-line validation
rows.reason: Target signal-quality tests already detect flatline/constant-run failures deterministically.

rows.capability: Expected sample-count and duration validation
rows.reason: Useful dataset-QA methodology; exact expected lengths depend on dataset-specific contracts.

rows.capability: Amplitude-outlier validation in millivolts
rows.reason: Useful offline QC only when units are trustworthy; donor itself skips this check for non-mV sources.

rows.capability: Validation issue aggregation and JSON quality report
rows.reason: Record-level issue accounting is useful QA infrastructure, not diagnostic performance evidence.

rows.capability: Croissant metadata generation and validation
rows.reason: Useful interoperability metadata for datasets; not required by governed runtime.

rows.capability: Remote dataset download and archive extraction
rows.reason: Mutable remote retrieval and archive extraction are incompatible with target exact-source controls without explicit hash and license admission gates.

rows.capability: Dataset manifest and checksum concepts
rows.reason: Target provenance manifests and exact hash controls are already stronger for governed evidence.

rows.capability: CLI for catalogue split Croissant upload and export workflows
rows.reason: Convenient research tooling but not a target runtime requirement.

rows.capability: Extensive config label split dataset and validation test suite
rows.reason: Broad regression methodology is useful reference; target closure uses its own non-clinical fixtures and governance assertions.

rows.capability: Dataset-specific caveat documentation for lead identity labels and source quirks
rows.reason: High-value research provenance/caveat material, but assertions must be independently verified before target operational use.

rows.capability: Dataset catalogue record/patient counts and published-result context
rows.reason: Counts and narrative are research context only; they are not target clinical metrics and may vary by dataset release.

rows.capability: Optional WFDB dependency for waveform loading
rows.reason: Canonical WFDB provenance is already DONOR-001; do not reattribute the dependency through ECGBench.

rows.capability: Optional PyTorch dependency for Dataset abstraction
rows.reason: PyTorch architecture/runtime surfaces were already audited under DONOR-004; no runtime dependency is added.

rows.capability: Repository publishing/deployment workflows
rows.reason: Package/docs publishing is unrelated to governed ECG runtime behavior.

rows.capability: Clinical/source provenance authority separation and fail-closed governance
rows.reason: ECGBench is research dataset infrastructure; target governance remains authoritative and must not be weakened.

cross_donor_deduplication.relationship: WFDB loading remains canonically attributed to MIT-LCP/wfdb-python.
PyTorch runtime/dependency provenance remains canonically audited under DeepPSP/torch_ecg.
PTB-XL/PTB-XL+ evaluation metadata overlaps prior benchmark audit; no duplicate dataset authority is created.
